warnings: Contour insert is a geometry and volume study. Its narrow-gap flow and actual diaphragm clearance are outside the acoustic model.
validation.acousticMessage: Contour insert: geometry and volume study only. The acoustic model does not yet represent flow through the cone gap and insert opening. Choose Open collector to use the existing acoustic screen.

status: Geometry and one-dimensional horn/driver acoustic screening; no full-field simulation or validated performance

assumptions.frontVolume: Smooth triangulated collector + polygon neck + conical recess minus optional triangulated contour insert
assumptions.frontFiller: Offset outlet follows the horn-entry projection through a cone-following insert. Cone depth and central relief are editable assumptions, not measured diaphragm or dust-cap geometry. Clearance is axial; surface tessellation adds conservative clearance. The provisional travel check uses entered peak excursion plus 1 mm. Narrow-gap acoustic loading is not modeled.
assumptions.paths: Straight distances to entry center; not acoustic transfer paths
assumptions.velocity: Piston continuity proxy; no cavity storage
assumptions.rear: One shared sealed or ported enclosure; total net volume, estimated displacement and coherent identical-mid acoustic approximation. No radiated rear/front sum.
